# Independent implementation and test review

An independent agent read the five changed production modules and the twelve
integration tests, including the private source-event mutant, without editing
them or running a build. It reported no actionable semantic or oracle defect.
The root subsequently checked the actual local run records; review alone was
not treated as execution evidence.

Reviewed identities:

- `tests/quantum_unit_maps.rs`: SHA-256
  `01d149412f26add1cd289eb414be0fb013baf7542d7739e9f7f96952d1fa981a`.
- `src/frontend/sized/lower/preservation.rs`: SHA-256
  `054bb96b3a53c1dddbda85ad7ea96de0eaf8aa991ea5bd8050681ebf58779f15`.

The review checked canonical +1, authored omega/i and controlled-Z equations,
external reference coefficients, owner/axis order, and wrong scalar proposals
that first obtain native acceptance against their own consistent meaning.
Their subsequent rejection uses unchanged external requests or original
direct-map source metadata. Isolated owner/type/effect negatives and the
remaining observation/profile limitations were checked separately.

This records advisory code review. It is not a human Guardian judgment,
formal source-preservation theorem, new guarantee admission or full CI result.
